The foci are (10,2) and (-16,2). The center is (-3,2), and the distance between the foci is 26, so c = 13. The condition |PF1 − PF2| = 24 gives 2a = 24, so a = 12. Then b² = c² − a² = 169 − 144 = 25, so b = 5.

Then h + k + a + b = -3 + 2 + 12 + 5 = 16.

Solution A is correct. Solution B mistakes the focal distance 26 for c, when it equals 2c, so its value of c is wrong.

WINNER: A
